evidence.notes: Intransitive sense matching the gloss (embarquer = to go on board) and transitive sense for putting people or goods aboard (embarquer des passagers).
Takes a direct object: embrasser quelqu'un (to kiss/embrace someone), per the usage note.
Takes a direct object: emporter quelque chose (to take something away), per the usage note.
Direct-object construction: engager quelqu'un (to hire) or engager une action (to commit/initiate); the s'engager à + infinitive construction is pronominal.
Takes a direct object or de + infinitive: envisager une possibilité / envisager de partir (to consider).
